description: This is a shell script that automates the build process for the AgentField software project. It includes setup, prerequisite checks, cleaning previous builds, testing path management, building UI components, cross-compiling the Go backend for multiple platforms, generating metadata, creating distribution packages, and displaying a build summary.
external_files: utils (imported in the test code snippet)

methods.name: command_exists
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: check_prerequisites
methods.description: Verifies required dependencies like Go, Node.js, and npm.

methods.name: clean_build
methods.description: Removes previous build artifacts and temporary files.

methods.name: test_path_system
methods.description: Runs a Go test program to verify the universal path management system.

methods.name: build_ui
methods.description: Installs dependencies and builds the embedded web UI.

methods.name: build_binary
methods.description: Cross-compiles the Go backend for specified OS and architecture, embedding the UI.

methods.name: build_all_binaries
methods.description: Builds the backend binary for multiple platforms.

methods.name: generate_metadata
methods.description: Produces checksum files and build information text.

methods.name: create_distribution
methods.description: Creates README and packaging details for distribution.

methods.name: show_summary
methods.description: Displays a summary of the build process and outputs.
